does: Writes a stats roll's die term into a tooltip's trans string: its value, '(NdM' with the damage type when one is given, the advantage or disadvantage mark and the label 'Critical!' when asked, then ')'; a roll of no dice is written as its flat value. Called by gui::StatsExprStringBuilder::StatsRoll before the modifiers.

evidence.says: writes the pattern '[1]d[2]' with the die size from the table at +0x552CF0C indexed by the roll's DiceValue (+0), the count at +1; only user of the loca handle h7c4ca846g7e48g446fg8887g7eca9b33af5d ('Critical!'); its callers are +0x178C0C0 and +0x14CEAE0, as the macOS build's Roll is called by StatsRoll
a count-only probe over a weapon hit shows 2 calls, both from +0x178C115 inside gui::StatsExprStringBuilder::StatsRoll (the attack roll and the damage roll)
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
